page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a decorative woodcut header at top; a historiated initial "H" opening the first verse; a horizontal rule separating two sections. Right-hand edge of the text runs into the page margin with a few partly clipped lines. No printed margin notes, no page number, no running head.

l.i: Quînam Omne se esse somniat qui sit Nihil?
Vindex, ab alto contuens te vertice?
Cunctator iram qui suam si differat,
Quis te hic ferat, ferre impotentem cæteros?
AT tu, otiari cui vnicum est negotium,

page.notes: The first word of the opening verse is a woodcut initial "H" joined to "EVS"; read as "HEVS" per the printed initial. The final line of the page is clipped at the right edge; "Induet" is partly cut off and read as "Indue[t]" with uncertainty. Some words near the right edge are cropped, e.g. "sonan-" and "inäbulat". Line "Et deerit huius scilicet superbia" and "Cunctator iram qui suam si differat" are read with [?] uncertainty where ink is faint: "differat" and "suam si" should be checked.
